title: AI transforms work environment and worker well-being
discussion_signal: The post shares the ILO working paper as a discussion of AI’s effects on the psychosocial work environment, specifically surveillance, changing job autonomy, data-driven management and mental and social well-being. A second public post found in the same search reinforces the concern that intrusive monitoring and reduced autonomy are experienced as workplace risks, while also acknowledging potential safety benefits.
linked_research_question: How does public workplace discussion convert AI management from an efficiency question into a question of autonomy, psychological safety, worker voice and integrated rights governance?
limits: LinkedIn posts are interpretive discussion, not representative worker evidence
The posts emphasize risks and do not quantify prevalence
The search result includes professional commentary rather than a structured debate sample
